Download the **Windows x64 ZIP** under Assets, extract it, and open **Work Hours Tracker.exe**. Python is included. The source archives require the Python setup described in the README.

First launch starts with an empty tracker. Set your own hourly rates and invoice details; cloud exports and AI remain optional.

Releases are unsigned. Compare the ZIP with the matching SHA256 asset, and keep Windows protection enabled. See the README and included quick start for setup and desktop-shortcut instructions.

Current scope: Windows 10/11 x64, GBP amounts and UK tax-year summaries. Back up your local data folder before updating.

Read the changelog for changes, PRIVACY.md for data handling and the licence documents for redistribution terms.
